audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text is built on 'ambush' language and male pronouns for a female champion, and never gives the range or cooldown that actually sets the spacing.
audit.why: Neeko is female (champ-gender.js). Tangle-Barbs (E) is a 1000-range root on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and it out-ranges Breath of Light's 750. That range gap, not the disguise, is why you lose the early lane.
audit.corrected: Play the lane off Tangle-Barbs' 1000 range: you cannot start a channel inside it while it is up, because the root cancels both Breath of Light and Astral Flight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike text called Pop Blossom a root, and named Aurelion Sol's ultimate 'Voice of Light' and his Q 'Q Starfire'.
audit.why: Riot's Pop Blossom text: after a short preparation she leaps, knocking up nearby enemies, and on landing damages and stuns them — knock-up then stun, at 600 range on 120/105/90s. The preparation is hidden while she is disguised. Aurelion Sol's are Breath of Light and Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike restated as a 600-range knock-up-and-stun with a hidden wind-up while disguised; your spikes are level 4 (Q while flying), 6 (Falling Star), and Rod of Ages.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated: that her root and her ult both cancel your two channels, and that immobilizing CC breaks her disguise.
audit.why: Riot's Inherent Glamour text: receiving immobilizing crowd control, or casting damaging spells, breaks the disguise. Both Breath of Light and Astral Flight are flagged interruptible channels, and Tangle-Barbs plus Pop Blossom are the only two hard-CC casts she has.
audit.corrected: State it: Falling Star's stun strips a disguised Neeko out of the wave, and her disguise also drops the instant she casts a damaging spell — so a champion that suddenly flickers is the wind-up. Astral Flight is your answer to the Pop Blossom prep: her ult only reaches 600, your flight travels 1500.

audit.why: 48.32% over 298 games is consistent with a losing early lane that flips on scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on rows 6 and 7: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Same row rendering two answers. The content layer matches the kit: permanent stardust versus a burst kit whose ult reaches 600 units.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and dosFull[2].d cited a fabricated 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed, plus a number that matches no ability — Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles; the cooldown replaced with the real one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Neeko is female — the full layer used he/his; corrected. Fabricated names removed: 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light' are not Aurelion Sol abilities (Breath of Light, Falling Star / The Skies Descend). Pop Blossom was described as a root everywhere; Riot's text is a knock-up on the leap and a stun on landing, 600 range, 120/105/90s, with the wind-up hidden while disguised. Two real interactions added that the page never stated: Tangle-Barbs (1000 range, 12s) cancels both of Aurelion Sol's channels, and immobilizing CC — including Falling Star's stun — breaks Inherent Glamour, as does her casting any damaging spell. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 6 and 7. Not asserted: whether Astral Flight's flight path denies the Pop Blossom leap — the terrain flag on Astral Flight contradicts Riot's text (he flies OVER terrain, he does not create it), so only the 1500-range escape is claimed.
